purpose: Turn many identical fresh chats into parent-grade cognitive workers that can execute, discover, plan locally, critique, verify, integrate locally, compile context and recover stalled work across four active surfaces without making the human or global guide the routine bottleneck.
claim_protocol: Normal work: create-if-absent coordination/opportunities/claims/<opportunity_id>.json. Dependency-blocked work is derived READY only when its activation rule is proven from exact durable dependency returns. Stale recovery uses a separate append-only recovery claim and never overwrites original evidence.
post_return: After every durable return, reload current bootstrap/state and re-enter allocation. Continue through as many safe useful sequential checkpoints/opportunities as context quality and authority allow; there is no one-extra-task cap.
surplus_capacity: If all prepared/dynamically-ready work is claimed, use authorized DISCOVERY mode to find a non-duplicate high-value problem, atomically pin a deterministic proposal fingerprint, publish an isolated proposal, then re-enter allocation. Do not invent filler.

acceptance_criteria: executable or reopenable artifact exists
evidence/receipts are machine-auditable
preserve-first and authority tests included
no global authority self-promotion

opportunities.mission: Implement append-only lease/heartbeat/stale-probe/recovery-attempt semantics. Never erase or overwrite original attempts; late returns remain candidate evidence.
